### God Carries You
Author: Annie Yorty
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/god-carries-you-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: Isaiah 46:3-4
Points:
- Human parents raise children toward independence, but God intends for His children to remain completely dependent on Him.
- Rather than carrying us only when our strength runs out, God sustains and carries us across our entire lifetime.
- Self-reliance and human pride inevitably fail, yet the Father tenderly scoops us up when we stumble.
- Because God is the tireless Creator, He never grows weak or weary under the weight of our burdens.
- Believers can let go of self-sufficiency and rest peacefully in the Father's constant embrace.

### A Prayer for the Weary Caregiver
Author: Angie Grant
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-nightly-prayer/a-prayer-for-the-weary-caregiver.html
Passage: Isaiah 46:4
Points:
- Long seasons of caregiving can feel crushingly heavy and emotionally draining.
- Much of our exhaustion comes from trying to carry worries and outcomes that only God was meant to bear.
- God created us and intimately understands the hidden, internal weariness of our hearts.
- True rest begins by shifting from self-reliant striving to quiet, faithful abiding.
- We find peace when we surrender our responsibilities to the God who promises to carry, sustain, and rescue us.

### A Prayer When You Are Faced with an Incurable Diagnosis
Author: Vivian Bricker
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-prayer/a-prayer-when-you-are-faced-with-an-incurable-diagnosis.html
Passage: Isaiah 46:10
Points:
- Facing an incurable illness brings deep grief and fear, but it does not mean life's purpose has ended.
- Sickness and hardship cannot derail or thwart God's sovereign plans for our lives.
- God declares the end from the beginning, guaranteeing that His divine purpose will stand firm.
- While suffering on earth is painful, Christians have the eternal hope of complete freedom from pain.
- Meditating on God's sovereignty and unchanging love provides strength to persevere each day.
